toegepas.rede_vinder: 'hierdie mere' points back to lakes the text has not yet named (only the heading does); the block should stand on its own.
toegepas.fout: 'hierdie mere' points back to lakes that only the heading names, because the sentence before it is a definition
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal names the lakes the heading already names, so the block stands on its own and no new fact is added.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A waterfall lies 'op' a river in Afrikaans, as the subject's other lessons write it ('lê op die Oranjerivier').
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: A waterfall lies 'in' a river in correct Afrikaans too, and the location does not change, so this is a lateral preposition swap.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'hoogste' and 'boonste' say the same thing here; the doubling is redundant.
na_skrywer.fout: the definition doubles 'hoogste' and 'boonste', which say the same thing
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The doubling is real, but rewording a glossary definition belongs to the writer, for every lesson that shares it.
